published.source: Shaman PR (rotation audit pass 21: Searing Totem before the pull, gated Lightning Shield recast, no totem recasts in the last 20 s, 2026-10-16)

summary: Sub-Restoration Enhancement with Water Shield and Mana Tide Totem for the group's mana, on the Magma Totem rotation with Mana Tide at 20% mana. It is 8.5% behind Level 60 at 180 s. It keeps Lightning Shield up rather than Water Shield, which was worth less at every raid hit rate tried.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -1.5 s; starting totems Strength of Earth IV, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring at -4 / -3 / -2 s, and Magma Totem 1 s before the pull
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20 s left
Mana Tide Totem at 20% mana or less; Mana Spring waits until the tide ends
Magma Totem when it is down and at least 10 s remain
Rage of the Farseer on cooldown, waiting for the on-use trinket; Blood Fury lined up with it; other cooldowns
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova above 20% mana (ahead of the shocks)
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Earth Shock while Flame Shock has more than 1 s left
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 2 a minute)
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Strength and 14 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Mana Tide Totem is worth about +0.1 for the shaman itself in a 3 min fight
Water Shield is inert at the preset's 0 raid hits; worth up to +4.1 at 6 hits a minute
Orc lead is mostly Axe Specialization from the synthetic axe; with weapon racials off Windshaper Skyborne leads
Maelstrom Weapon proc rate (2 PPM per point) is an assumption until beta reaches level 34
Elemental Focus trigger set: if Stormstrike can trigger it, Enhancement gets too few Clearcasting procs
Raid damage hits on the shaman (2 a minute, which fires Lightning Shield) are an estimate from boss timers, not measured in logs; the assumptions panel runs 0 and 10
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl mana_tide (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid's only totem is a second shaman's Grace of Air, standards 25, the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring Totem itself) ; edited startingTotems.fire to MagmaTotem with fireSecondsBeforePull 1, as the preset ships.
